sources.description: Inspect failed workspace requests. Requires one of the customer request IDs.
Inspect requests from a retry after an attempted fix. Requires a new retry request ID.

questions.text: What happens when they try, who is affected, and which request IDs are shown?

event.text: Our workspace stopped working after the migration.

facts.customer_report: Our workspace stopped working after the migration.
facts.account: Workspace W6; active business account; migration completed yesterday. Account administrator is available.

policy.text: Support may inspect request records. Only an authorized administrator may refresh cached access, and only if a failed request used an older denied permission while current permission allows access. Confirm customer recovery after any fix. Engineers can inspect render-service logs; the rep cannot.

facts.support_policy: Only an authorized administrator may refresh cached access when an older denied permission was used and current permission allows access. Confirm customer recovery. Render-service logs require engineering.

record.text: T71, T72, T73: W6, users U17–U19. Access denied using permission version 4. Current version 5 allows these users access.

facts.request_permissions: T71, T72, T73 used denied permission version 4 for U17–U19 on W6.
facts.current_permissions: Current permission version 5 allows U17–U19 access to W6.

record.text: T74, T75, T76: permission version 5, access allowed, rendering HTTP 503. Only engineering can inspect render-service logs.

facts.retry_requests: T74, T75, T76: permission version 5 allowed access; rendering returned HTTP 503.
